cocktails.name: Full Moon Party
cocktails.description: A firm customer favourite since 2022, featuring lemongrass-infused vodka, goji berry liqueur and our secret dragonfruit sauce, finished with citrus and lightly spiced ginger beer.

cocktails.name: Dew Like Pina Coladas?
cocktails.description: Out refreshing twist on a summer classic using fresh honeydew melon cordial.

cocktails.name: Bubblegum Daiquri
cocktails.description: Our theatrical twist on the classic daiquiri, bursting with bubblegum flavours and crowned with a smoke bubble.

cocktails.name: The Jaw Dropper
cocktails.description: A tropical blend of banana and spiced rums, bright citrus and island spice, served in the jaws of a shark tiki mug with a blood-red cherry float.

cocktails.name: Tonka Time
cocktails.description: Bright, tropical, and gently spiced.

cocktails.name: Watermelon Sugar High
cocktails.description: A modern crowd-pleaser of pisco, watermelon, lychee, and lime, finished ice-cold and irresistibly fresh - We are sure Harry Styles would approve of this signature cocktail!

cocktails.name: Aperol Spritz
cocktails.description: Bright citrus and orange flavors are balanced by gentle herbal bitterness and crisp sparkling wine, creating a light, effervescent drink that's perfect for warm weather or pre-dinner sipping.

cocktails.name: Apple & Pear Highball
cocktails.description: Layers of ripe apple and juicy pear are complemented by rich orchard fruit, subtle oak, and a smooth whisky character, finished with refreshing bubbles for an elegant, easy-drinking serve.

cocktails.name: Bajan Rum Punch
cocktails.description: A top-secret family recipe from our Barbadian friend and former colleague, this Mount Gay rum punch is a must-have for any garden party.

cocktails.name: Bellini
cocktails.description: A timeless Venetian classic of ripe peach puree topped with chilled prosecco.

cocktails.name: Berry Caiprioska
cocktails.description: Our Berry Caiprioska is a favorite all year round, it packs a punch and is the perfect mix of sweet and tart.

cocktails.name: Bob's Negroni
cocktails.description: A twist on the classic Negroni for our good friend and web developer Robert using Genever instead of gin.

cocktails.name: Bramble
cocktails.description: A modern British classic, blending gin, fresh lemon, and rich blackberry liqueur over crushed ice.

cocktails.name: Candy Cane Martini
cocktails.description: Christmas just got a little more magical with this cocktail! A perfect blend of Christmas cheer, garnished with a sugary Candy Cane rim.

cocktails.name: Cantaloupe & Peach Martini
cocktails.description: Fresh cantaloupe and peach layered over vodka and dry vermouth for a fragrant, fruit-forward twist on a classic Martini.

cocktails.name: Cantarito Maldito
cocktails.description: Translating to “The Cursed Little Jug,” this one brings the heat — perfectly balanced spice, citrus, and smoke.

cocktails.name: Catch Of The Day
cocktails.description: Reel in a taste of the tropics with coconut rum, guava, lychee and lime, finished with island spice and served in a fish-shaped tiki mug over crushed ice

cocktails.name: Champagne Supernova
cocktails.description: Named after Oasis and created as the ultimate hangover cure, this sparkling blend of Rock Rose gin, lychee, pineapple, coconut, and Champagne is pure celestial indulgence.

cocktails.name: Classic Champagne
cocktails.description: Originating in 19th-century France, this elegant Champagne cocktail blends cognac, sugar, and bitters with sparkling finesse.

cocktails.name: Cosmopolitan
cocktails.description: A glamorous contemporary icon of vodka, cranberry, citrus, and orange liqueur, made famous in 90s New York.

cocktails.name: Cotton Candy Cosmopolitan
cocktails.description: Our twist on the classic cocktail.

cocktails.name: Cotton Headed Ninny Muggins
cocktails.description: Inspired by everyone's favourite holiday film, Elf, this whimsical cocktail is guaranteed to bring Christmas cheer to even the grumpiest Grinch!

cocktails.name: Daiquri
cocktails.description:
Born in Cuba, this crisp rum classic balances fresh lime and subtle sweetness.
Flavours are available upon request.

cocktails.name: Dragon Blood
cocktails.description: A mysterious purple showstopper served in a chemistry beaker, full of bold flavour.

cocktails.name: Egg Nog
cocktails.description: Eggnog is always a must have over the Christmas period!

cocktails.name: Espresso Martini
cocktails.description: Made famous by Kate Moss, this London-born icon blends smooth vodka with rich coffee elegance.

cocktails.name: French Martini
cocktails.description: A modern Parisian-inspired favorite with vodka, pineapple, and raspberry.

cocktails.name: French Pear Fizz
cocktails.description: Our signature Champagne cocktail, sugar-rimmed and stirred with pear and elderflower, then topped with brut Champagne, perfect for every celebration.

cocktails.name: From The Ashes
cocktails.description: Sophisticated, balanced and perfectly spooky, with our Mint Ash stealing the show.

cocktails.name: Galentine's Wine
cocktails.description: A delicate lychee and rose wine spritz, light, floral, and perfect for celebrations with your favourite people.

cocktails.name: Gold Digger
cocktails.description: A luxe reimagining of a classic Daiquiri, with buttery popcorn flavour and a golden shimmer.

cocktails.name: Grave Digger

cocktails.name: Grinch Hopper
cocktails.description: Our festive twist on a classic Flip.

cocktails.description: A crisp and refreshing Italian cocktail made with Prosecco, elderflower liqueur, soda water, fresh mint, and lime. Delicate floral notes are balanced with bright citrus and lively bubbles, creating a light, fragrant spritz that's perfect for warm days and aperitivo hour.

cocktails.name: Hula Juice
cocktails.description: Tropical, bittersweet, and beautifully theatrical tequila, passionfruit, banana, lime, and candy floss magic.

cocktails.name: In A Pickle
cocktails.description: We went too far looking for flavours to use in Margarita twists and got ourselves in a pickle, turns out it works! Zesty, salty and unapologetically briny.

cocktails.name: Jamaican Passion
cocktails.description: Short, sweet, and wildly tropical

cocktails.name: Jungle Bird
cocktails.description: Rich notes of molasses and ripe pineapple are balanced by bright citrus and a touch of bittersweet complexity, creating a refreshing cocktail with a smooth, exotic finish.

cocktails.description: A refreshing Italian spritz made with Luxardo Limoncello, Prosecco, and a splash of soda water. Bursting with vibrant lemon citrus, balanced sweetness, and crisp bubbles, it's a light, zesty cocktail with a clean, refreshing finish.

cocktails.name: Little Kisses
cocktails.description: A playful Champagne cocktail of elderberry, cacao, and sparkling indulgence.

cocktails.description: Lost in Fermentation, a trans-Pacific misunderstanding involving pisco, cucumber and sparkling sake.

cocktails.name: Manhattan

cocktails.name: Margarita
cocktails.description: A legendary Mexican classic with bright lime and premium tequila.

cocktails.description: A timeless classic, served just the way you like it. Choose your preferred gin or vodka, shaken or stirred, with a twist or olives. Crisp, elegant, and spirit-forward, the Martini is a cocktail that's as personal as it is iconic.

cocktails.name: Mojito
cocktails.description: Havana's refreshing signature of mint, lime, and light rum.

cocktails.name: Negroni

cocktails.name: Old Fashioned
cocktails.description: A timeless whisky classic, perfected with sugar, bitters, and refined restraint.

cocktails.name: Pa Rum Pum Pum Plum

cocktails.name: Paloma

cocktails.name: Partridge In A Pear Tree

cocktails.name: Pina Colada
cocktails.description: If you like getting caught in the rain, this creamy coconut and pineapple classic is your tropical escape.

cocktails.name: Pomegranate & Rosemary Bellini
cocktails.description: Our twist on the classic Bellini

cocktails.name: Pornstar Martini
cocktails.description: A sophisticated crowd-pleaser, marrying exotic passionfruit with velvety vanilla vodka.

cocktails.name: Pressed To Impress
cocktails.description: House-pressed Pink Lady apple and rhubarb juice paired with gin and lengthened over ice for a bright, orchard-fresh highball.

cocktails.name: Pumpkin Pie
cocktails.description: A warm, luxurious pumpkin pie cocktail with a rich cream float and autumnal spice.

cocktails.name: Reindeer Juice
cocktails.description: Would you try carrots in your cocktail?

Bright, refreshing, and effortlessly stylish, it's the perfect drink for sunny days and golden evenings.
